sources.title: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
sources.locator: §4.2.4 Text Quote Selector; §4.2.5 Text Position Selector; §4.3 States and §4.3.1 Time State
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official W3C URL and directly opened the cited locator sections via web. The web tool did not expose individual request timestamps; this source was read in the 2026-10-12T04:26:13Z–04:27:25Z observed window.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: TextQuoteSelector stores normalized selected text and may still match multiple passages; the specification warns that copying restricted text into an annotation may be dangerous. TextPositionSelector avoids copying quote text but is brittle under edits/transcluded content. State describes the intended source version or format and must be processed before selectors.
sources.applicability: Supports recipient-safe quote handling and binding a passage selector to the intended source representation. It does not provide application authorization, retention, or source authenticity.

sources.observed_operation: Opened the official Microsoft Learn URL and directly opened the downloadUrl locator via web. The web tool did not expose individual request timestamps; this source was read in the 2026-10-12T04:26:13Z–04:27:25Z observed window.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A specific version has an ID and can be retrieved, but its download URL requires no authentication, is short-lived (up to one hour), cannot be cached, and may remain usable briefly after a file permission is removed.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft’s warning not to use a temporary download URL as a durable, revocable citation. It illustrates one provider’s behavior and is not a universal version or authorization guarantee.
